facts.text: The help-desk chatbot pilot ran for 6 weeks with one support team
38% of incoming tickets were answered by the bot without a person
Average first response time fell from 4 hours to 2 minutes
Customer satisfaction stayed at 4.5 out of 5, the same as before
Next: add two more teams in Q1, then all teams in Q2
Every bot answer links to the policy page it is based on
